passages.pageText: Your final interview standard DO NOT SOUND LIKE A GLOSSARY Definitions are the starting line. Connect each concept to a real product behavior, trade-off, and failure mode. DO NOT ARCHITECT FOR EGO A clear modular monolith can be more senior than five premature microservices. Choose complexity only when requirements pay for it. MEASURE BEFORE OPTIMIZING Profile React. EXPLAIN ANALYZE the query. Measure hit rate. Track TTFT. Load-test capacity. Evidence beats intuition. PROTECT INVARIANTS AT THE RIGHT LAYER UI validation helps users. Backend authorization protects resources. Database constraints protect data. Each layer has a job. THINK IN FAILURE PATHS What if the request returns late? The cache is stale? The worker crashes? The model hallucinates? The replica lags? That is mid-level thinking.
